answers: design finding 1: done — Rewrote DSCLA-9's `When:` from "runner.sh processes the return value and exits without dispatching stages" (internal mechanism) to "the runner is started on that issue" (the observable triggering action). Also updated the `Given:` from internal variable state (`zbuild_claim_acquire returns 1 and _ZBUILD_CLAIM_HOLDER is set`) to the observable pre-condition (`zbuild:claimed is on the issue and a claim comment with a holder string exists`), so both clauses now describe what a test can observe rather than how the code implements it.
